no_bridge: Cannot reach the core: see the error gqy-web printed

boot.title: Cannot reach the core
boot.down_why: The web software is not running, or the core cannot be reached.
boot.down_how: Run gqy web in a terminal and open the link it prints.
boot.core_how: Look at the error in the terminal that started gqy-web.

login.title: Log in
login.bad_user: The username starts with a lowercase letter and has only lowercase letters, digits, - and _

setup.title: Set a username and password
setup.hint: First time (or reset): after this you log in with them; remembered on this device for 30 days.

login.long_user: The username is at most 32 characters
login.short_password: The password is at least 8 characters
login.long_password: The password is at most 1024 characters
login.blank_password: The password cannot be only whitespace
